question: Show all pairs of entertainers and customers who each have up to three style strengths or preferences, where the first and second style preferences of the customers match the first and second style strengths of the entertainers (or in reverse order). Only return the entertainer’s stage name and the customer’s last name
sql:
-- Final query: pairs of entertainers and customers where first and second preferences/strengths match
WITH cust_prefs AS (
  SELECT 
    CustomerID,
    MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN StyleID END) AS pref1,
    MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN StyleID END) AS pref2
  FROM Musical_Preferences
  GROUP BY CustomerID
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN StyleID END) IS NOT NULL 
     AND MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN StyleID END) IS NOT NULL
),
ent_styles_ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    EntertainerID,
    StyleID,
    StyleStrength,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EntertainerID ORDER BY StyleStrength DESC, StyleID) AS rn
  FROM Entertainer_Styles
),
ent_strengths AS (
  SELECT 
    EntertainerID,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN StyleID END) AS strength1,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN StyleID END) AS strength2
  FROM ent_styles_ranked
  GROUP BY EntertainerID
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN StyleID END) IS NOT NULL 
     AND MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN StyleID END) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  e.EntStageName,
  c.CustLastName
FROM cust_prefs cp
JOIN ent_strengths es ON (cp.pref1 = es.strength1 AND cp.pref2 = es.strength2) 
                   OR (cp.pref1 = es.strength2 AND cp.pref2 = es.strength1)
JOIN Entertainers e ON e.EntertainerID = es.EntertainerID
JOIN Customers c ON c.CustomerID = cp.CustomerID
ORDER BY e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName
